name: Cork of the Deep Cellar
summary: A cork that seals a container so nothing can get in or out.
description: Found in the cellars of old inns, stuck in a bottle no one has opened. The cork never dries.

stats.effect: As a Magic action, you can press this cork into a container no larger than a barrel. For 1 hour, nothing can pass into or out of the container, and its contents are shielded from detection. The cork is consumed.
